## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The PR has one coherent outcome and explicit exclusions.
- [ ] Interactive elements are keyboard accessible and properly labelled.
- [ ] Images have useful alternative text and external links are safe.
- [ ] Client-side code and third-party scripts are kept to the necessary minimum.
- [ ] Documentation changes are included with the implementation.
